rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an accountant, including someone who handles a person’s or organization’s accounts.

example.english: The company hired an accountant to check our books.
example.traditional: 公司請咗個會計幫我哋對數。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 wui6 gai3 bong1 ngo5 dei6 deoi3 sou3

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that the person is a professional accountant, especially one with professional credentials.

example.english: When it was time to file taxes, we asked an accountant for help.
example.traditional: 報稅嗰陣，我哋搵會計師幫手。
example.jyutping: bou3 seoi3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 wan2 wui6 gai3 si1 bong1 sau2
